# Transkribus

> Transkribus is an AI-powered platform for handwritten document digitization, text recognition, and digital scholarly publishing that unlocks historical archives through advanced machine learning.

Transkribus provides end-to-end solutions for archives, researchers, and genealogists to digitize, transcribe, and publish historical documents using state-of-the-art handwriting recognition models. The platform serves institutions across Europe and beyond, with features including full-text search, GDPR compliance, and integration capabilities through the metagrapho API.

## Key Topics

- Handwriting Recognition
- Historical Documents
- Document Digitization

## Platform Overview

- [Transkribus - Unlock History](https://www.transkribus.org): Homepage for Transkribus AI platform for handwritten document digitization
- [Plans & Pricing](https://www.transkribus.org/plans): Pricing plans and subscription tiers for Transkribus platform services

## Solutions by Use Case

- [Transkribus for Archives](https://www.transkribus.org/for-archives): Transkribus solution for archives: mass digitization, full-text search, GDPR-compliant
- [Transkribus for Researchers](https://www.transkribus.org/for-researchers): Transkribus for researchers: text recognition, entity tagging, API automation
- [Transkribus for Genealogy](https://www.transkribus.org/genealogy): Transkribus for genealogy: AI-powered handwriting recognition for family documents

## AI Models & Recognition

- [AI Models Catalog](https://www.transkribus.org/models): Catalog of 406+ AI models for text recognition, layout analysis, and extraction
- [The Text Titan I (Super Model)](https://www.transkribus.org/models/the-text-titan-i-super-model): Text Titan I Super Model: multilingual OCR for German, English, Dutch, French
- [The Text Titan I ter](https://www.transkribus.org/models/the-text-titan-i-ter): Text Titan I ter model: general-purpose text recognition for Latin scripts
- [Dutch Dean (Super Model)](https://www.transkribus.org/models/dutch-dean-super-model): Dutch Dean Super Model: Dutch text recognition for handwritten and printed texts
- [Dansk Dokumentalist (Super Model)](https://www.transkribus.org/models/dansk-dokumentalist-super-model): Dansk Dokumentalist Super Model: Danish text recognition for manuscripts

## API & Integration

- [metagrapho API](https://www.transkribus.org/metagrapho): metagrapho REST API for handwritten text recognition and document processing

## Digital Scholarly Editions

- [Transkribus Sites](https://www.transkribus.org/sites): Gallery of 82 searchable digital editions published with Transkribus Sites
- [Ton Koopman Keywords](https://www.transkribus.org/sites/ton_koopman_keywords): Digital scholarly edition of Ton Koopman keywords published via Transkribus Sites
- [Stadsarchief Mechelen](https://www.transkribus.org/sites/stadsarchiefmechelen): Mechelen city archive digital edition published via Transkribus Sites
